headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment tools to improve the security and efficiency of ClearInstall, ensuring users are informed about potential risks before installation. Leverage AI-driven analysis for better accuracy in identifying vulnerabilities.
actions: Implement a real-time threat intelligence API to scan package dependencies against known vulnerabilities during the install process.
Develop an AI-powered risk assessment module that can dynamically analyze and predict potential issues based on user-specific context and environment configurat
Create a customizable alert system for users, notifying them of any identified risks and providing guidance on how to mitigate them.
